ctbids-47872-5568323.description:
An exquisite collection of vintage and antique jewelry presented inside a gold-tooled embossed brown leather jewelry box with a soft velvet-lined interior. Highlights of this lot include fine sterling and 800 silver pieces, starring a signed Eisenberg Original sterling ribbon bow brooch, a filigree link bracelet set with dark red cabochons, an 1879 Morgan silver dollar pendant, a hallmarked .925 oval locket, Norwegian Solje-style filigree brooches with dangles, filigree floral cufflinks/buttons, and a small cameo pendant.
Lot Details:
 Leather Box: Tooled gilt detailing on top lid, deep brown velvet interior, hinge top opening
 Key Featured Pieces:
 Eisenberg Original Sterling bow brooch with large emerald-cut center stone
 Filigree panel link bracelet with bezel-set deep red cabochons (marked 800)
 1879 Liberty head coin set in a pendant bezel frame
 Sterling silver (.925) hinged oval locket with intricate outer engraving
 Traditional Solje-style circular filigree brooch with gilded dangling spoons/disks (marked 830S)
 Solje-style circular brooch with raised stud accents and dangles
 Silver filigree flower button/cufflink pair and small cameo charm
Condition: Overall vintage to antique condition. Silver displays age-appropriate patina and tarnish (can be polished if desired). Leather box shows surface scuffing and edge wear. Please refer to photos for exact details.

275412013.description:
Amethyst Crystal Cluster Lot - 2 Pieces
Natural Mineral Specimens
Purple / Lavender, Druzy Geode Formations
Natural amethyst crystal clusters featuring dense druzy formations on a contrasting rocky matrix. These specimens display the characteristic transition from raw host stone to crystalline purple quartz. Ideal for mineral collectors or home decor, these pieces represent the natural beauty of geode interiors.
Pieces Included:
Amethyst Druzy Cluster: Deep purple crystal points with a thick rocky matrix base.
Amethyst Druzy Cluster: Lavender crystal points with a stable host stone matrix.
Natural crystalline druzy texture with varying shades of purple
Solid rock matrix bases providing stability for display
Combined weight of 1.75 lbs; pair measures approximately 6x5x3 inches
Condition:
Specimens in excellent natural condition. Well-preserved crystal terminations with no post-extraction damage. The matrix is stable and free of crumbling. Natural geological variations in color and structure are present as expected.
